{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the revenue column: is it really text with commas?
print(sales['revenue'].head())

# Check for the presence of commas
print("\nAre there commas in the revenue column?", sales['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False).any())

# Also check for the special QA rows (999999.99)
print("\nNumber of QA rows (revenue == 999999.99):", (sales['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum())"}
